_comment: Extra coupled-limit rule file (v7): the rule arm_wing, used together with config/coupled_limits_v7.json (all rules there stay in force). Angles in degrees, offsets from the rest pose, left-written joint names. Exact triangle distance >= 2.5 mm; tested by sampling, not proven.
v8 (20-joint Kobi, 2026-11-25): rule arm_wing with arm_yaw frozen at 0 (table cut at the node 0.0), made by scripts/make_coupled_limits_v8.py from coupled_limits_v7_armwing.json.

rules.applies_to: each arm, in every one of the seven arm boxes; left-written numbers, the right arm uses the same numbers (the shoulder and elbow axes of the right side are mirrored; the arm yaw is frozen at 0 and is not a joint of the 20-joint model)
rules.not_in_rule: waist_yaw (the arm chain and the wings both sit on the torso link, so the waist does not change their distance: relative transforms equal to 1e-13), neck (head and neck are not in the pair), wrist (measured at +-45 in the verification, the hand never came near); arm_yaw (frozen at 0 in the 20-joint edition: the table is the slice of the 25-joint table at the arm_yaw node 0.0)
rules.inequality: shoulder_pitch <= pitch_cap(shoulder_roll, elbow); arm_yaw is frozen at 0 (a node of the 25-joint table, whose slice at that node is this table); the old arm box of the roll still bounds the pitch from above, the stricter of the two holds
evaluation_order: 1. the pose must be inside the old arm box of its shoulder roll (a roll on a shared boundary: both boxes) and satisfy the other rules (arm_head, ...)

2. on each of the two axes (shoulder roll, elbow) take the nearest node at or below and the nearest node at or above the value (a value on a node: that node only; outside the node range: the end node)
3. pitch_cap = the smallest table value among those (up to 4) nodes
4. shoulder_pitch must be <= pitch_cap (a table value of 60 equals the end of every arm box: no limit beyond the box); rolls above the last roll node use the last node (no limit measured there)
rules.pair: arm chain parts (shoulder caps, upper sleeves, elbow ball, forearm sleeves, cuff band, mitten, brackets and servos of the arm links) against Wing_L and Wing_R, exact manifold3d min_gap >= 2.5 mm

tested_with.note: the table is the arm_yaw = 0 slice of the table measured for v7; the 20-joint poses are a subset of the poses measured there; not re-measured

v7_tested_with.parts: final v7 set (shell_v7/listing_light.json; arm 16o incl. hands; wings W2c4c; hardware results/shell_v6g/integration/hw_parts_v6)
v7_tested_with.pair: every arm part (shells, brackets, servos of shoulder, upperarm, armyaw, forearm, hand) against Wing_L and Wing_R, exact manifold3d min_gap, search 6 mm

waist.conclusion: the waist does not change the arm-wing distance

removal_from_old_boxes.arm_near_body_roll2_5: 0.142 percent of the box volume (37.7 percent of the roll/yaw/elbow columns lose up to 1.0 degree of pitch)
removal_from_old_boxes.arm_near_body_roll5_10: 0.015 percent (3.1 percent of the columns, up to 1.0 degree)
